title: Elon Musk Spends Heavily to Back Ken Paxton’s Senate Bid in Texas
summary: The world’s richest person, who has become the biggest known midterm donor, gave $158 million to a group that quickly spent that much to help Mr. Paxton’s Senate bid in Texas.
